```python
from contextlib import contextmanager
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any, cast
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import requests

class FakeApi(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def __init__(self) -> None:

        seed = [("Ana", "admin", True), ("Luis", "tester", True), ("Eva", "viewer", False)]

            i: {"id": i, "name": n, "email": f"{n.lower()}@qa.io", "role": r, "active": a}
            for i, (n, r, a) in enumerate(seed, start=1)}
        self.next_id, self.flaky_left, self.connections = 4, 2, 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}"

    def process_request(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.connections += 1
        super().process_request(request, client_address)

    def handle_error(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Silencia clientes que cortan la conexión (por ejemplo, por timeout)


def user_errors(body: Any, partial: bool) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):

    errors = [] if partial else [f for f in ("name", "email", "role") if f not in body]
    errors += ["role"] if body.get("role", ROLES[0]) not in ROLES else []
    errors += ["email"] if "@" not in str(body.get("email", "@")) else []
    return errors + sorted(set(body) - {"name", "email", "role", "active"})


class FakeApiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # Todos los métodos HTTP pasan por aquí (ver la última línea)
        url = urlparse(self.path)

        except json.JSONDecodeError:

                   "Content-Length": str(len(data))} | headers
        self.send_response(status)

            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_GET

    def route(self, api: FakeApi, path: str, query: dict[str, str], body: Any) -> Reply:
        parts, method = [p for p in path.split("/") if p], self.command
        if parts == ["health"]:
            return 200, {"status": "ok"}, {}
        if parts == ["slow"]:
            time.sleep(delay := float(query.get("delay", "0.2")))
            return 200, {"waited": delay}, {}
        if parts == ["flaky"]:
            with api.lock:
                api.flaky_left -= 1
                if api.flaky_left >= 0:
                    return 503, {"error": "unavailable"}, {"Retry-After": "0"}
            return 200, {"status": "recovered"}, {}
        if parts == ["login"] and method == "POST":
            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("username") == "admin" \
                    and body.get("password") == "secret":
                cookie = {"Set-Cookie": f"session={TOKEN}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}
                return 200, {"token": TOKEN, "expires_in": 3600}, cookie
            return 401, {"error": "invalid_credentials"}, {}
        if parts == ["app", "users"]:
            if f"session={TOKEN}" not in (self.headers.get("Cookie") or ""):
                return 401, "<h1>Inicia sesión</h1>", {}
            with api.lock:
                rows = "".join(f"<tr data-testid='user-{u['id']}'><td>{html.escape(u['name'])}</td>"
                               f"<td>{html.escape(u['email'])}</td><td>{u['role']}</td></tr>"
                               for u in api.users.values())
            return 200, f"<h1>Usuarios</h1><table><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>", {}
        if parts[:1] != ["users"]:
            return 404, {"error": "route_not_found", "path": path}, {}
        if self.headers.get("Authorization") != f"Bearer {TOKEN}":
            return 401, {"error": "unauthorized"}, {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
        with api.lock:
            return self.users(api, method, parts[1:], query, body)

    def users(self, api: FakeApi, method: str, rest: list[str], query: dict[str, str],
              body: Any) -> Reply:
        if not rest and method == "GET":
            page, size = int(query.get("page", "1")), int(query.get("size", "10"))
            if page < 1 or not 1 <= size <= 100:
                return 400, {"error": "invalid_pagination"}, {}
            rows = [u for u in api.users.values() if query.get("role") in (None, u["role"])]
            items = rows[(page - 1) * size:page * size]
            return 200, {"items": items, "page": page, "size": size, "total": len(rows)}, {}
        if not rest and method == "POST":
            if errors := user_errors(body, partial=False):
                return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}
        user_id = int(rest[0])
        if (current := api.users.get(user_id)) is None:
            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}
        return 200, api.users[user_id], {}


@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---

TIMEOUT = 5.0


def make_session(token: str) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Accept": "application/json"})
    return session


def run_crud_cycle(session: requests.Session, base: str) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    steps: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    created = session.post(f"{base}/users", timeout=TIMEOUT,
                           json={"name": "Ciclo", "email": "ciclo@qa.io", "role": "tester"})
    created.raise_for_status()  # Si el setup falla, no tiene sentido seguir
    user = created.json()
    assert created.headers["Location"] == f"/users/{user['id']}"
    steps.append(("POST", created.status_code))
    url = f"{base}/users/{user['id']}"

    read = session.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    assert read.json() == user
    steps.append(("GET", read.status_code))

    patched = session.patch(url, json={"active": False}, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    assert patched.json() == user | {"active": False}  # Solo cambió 'active'
    steps.append(("PATCH", patched.status_code))

    replaced = session.put(url, timeout=TIMEOUT,
                           json={"name": "Ciclo PUT", "email": "ciclo@qa.io", "role": "admin"})
    assert replaced.json() == {"id": user["id"], "active": True, "name": "Ciclo PUT",
                               "email": "ciclo@qa.io", "role": "admin"}
    steps.append(("PUT", replaced.status_code))

    deleted = session.delete(url, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    assert deleted.content == b""  # 204: sin cuerpo
    steps.append(("DELETE", deleted.status_code))

    steps.append(("GET", session.get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT).status_code))
    return steps


def run_self_tests() -> None:
    with running_api() as api:
        with make_session(TOKEN) as session:
            assert run_crud_cycle(session, api.base_url) == [
                ("POST", 201), ("GET", 200), ("PATCH", 200),
                ("PUT", 200), ("DELETE", 204), ("GET", 404),
            ]
        with make_session("token-falso") as session:
            try:
                run_crud_cycle(session, api.base_url)
            except requests.HTTPError as error:
                assert error.response is not None and error.response.status_code == 401
            else:
                raise AssertionError("Con un token inválido debía fallar el primer paso")
    print("Ejercicio 11.2: todas las pruebas pasaron.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_self_tests()
```

#### Ejercicio 11.3: Reintentos configurables ante errores transitorios

**Enunciado**

El endpoint `/flaky` falla con `503` las dos primeras veces. Escribe:

- `build_session(retries: int | None) -> requests.Session`: si `retries` es `None`, una sesión sin reintentos; si es un número, monta un `HTTPAdapter` con `Retry(total=retries, status_forcelist=(502, 503, 504), backoff_factor=0.01)` limitado a métodos idempotentes.
- `probe_flaky(base, retries) -> int | str`: llama una vez a `GET /flaky` con esa sesión y devuelve el código final, o el texto `"RetryError"` si se agotaron los reintentos.

Cada caso debe ejecutarse contra una API **recién arrancada** (para que el contador de fallos empiece de cero).

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| `retries` | Llamadas que recibe el servidor | Resultado de `probe_flaky` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | 1 | `503` |
| `1` | 2 | `"RetryError"` |
| `2` | 3 | `200` |
| `5` | 3 | `200` (sobran reintentos: se detiene al primer éxito) |

**Solución comentada**

```python
import html
import json
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any, cast
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

# --- API falsa compacta (versión completa explicada en 11.1.2): puedes saltarte este tramo ---
TOKEN = "token-123"
ROLES = ("admin", "tester", "viewer")
Reply = tuple[int, object, dict[str, str]]  # (código, cuerpo JSON o HTML, cabeceras extra)


class FakeApi(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeApiHandler)
        seed = [("Ana", "admin", True), ("Luis", "tester", True), ("Eva", "viewer", False)]
        self.users: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {
            i: {"id": i, "name": n, "email": f"{n.lower()}@qa.io", "role": r, "active": a}
            for i, (n, r, a) in enumerate(seed, start=1)}
        self.next_id, self.flaky_left, self.connections = 4, 2, 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}"

    def process_request(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.connections += 1
        super().process_request(request, client_address)

    def handle_error(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Silencia clientes que cortan la conexión (por ejemplo, por timeout)


def user_errors(body: Any, partial: bool) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return ["body"]
    errors = [] if partial else [f for f in ("name", "email", "role") if f not in body]
    errors += ["role"] if body.get("role", ROLES[0]) not in ROLES else []
    errors += ["email"] if "@" not in str(body.get("email", "@")) else []
    return errors + sorted(set(body) - {"name", "email", "role", "active"})


class FakeApiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"  # Conexiones persistentes (keep-alive)

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Sin log por petición en stderr

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # Todos los métodos HTTP pasan por aquí (ver la última línea)
        url = urlparse(self.path)
        size = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        query = {key: values[0] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query).items()}
        try:
            body: Any = json.loads(self.rfile.read(size)) if size else None
            status, payload, headers = self.route(cast(FakeApi, self.server), url.path, query, body)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            status, payload, headers = 400, {"error": "invalid_json"}, {}
        is_html = isinstance(payload, str)
        text = str(payload) if is_html else "" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload)
        data = text.encode()
        headers = {"Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" if is_html else "application/json",
                   "Content-Length": str(len(data))} | headers
        self.send_response(status)
        for key, value in headers.items():
            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_GET

    def route(self, api: FakeApi, path: str, query: dict[str, str], body: Any) -> Reply:
        parts, method = [p for p in path.split("/") if p], self.command
        if parts == ["health"]:
            return 200, {"status": "ok"}, {}
        if parts == ["slow"]:
            time.sleep(delay := float(query.get("delay", "0.2")))
            return 200, {"waited": delay}, {}
        if parts == ["flaky"]:
            with api.lock:
                api.flaky_left -= 1
                if api.flaky_left >= 0:
                    return 503, {"error": "unavailable"}, {"Retry-After": "0"}
            return 200, {"status": "recovered"}, {}
        if parts == ["login"] and method == "POST":
            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("username") == "admin" \
                    and body.get("password") == "secret":
                cookie = {"Set-Cookie": f"session={TOKEN}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}
                return 200, {"token": TOKEN, "expires_in": 3600}, cookie
            return 401, {"error": "invalid_credentials"}, {}
        if parts == ["app", "users"]:
            if f"session={TOKEN}" not in (self.headers.get("Cookie") or ""):
                return 401, "<h1>Inicia sesión</h1>", {}
            with api.lock:
                rows = "".join(f"<tr data-testid='user-{u['id']}'><td>{html.escape(u['name'])}</td>"
                               f"<td>{html.escape(u['email'])}</td><td>{u['role']}</td></tr>"
                               for u in api.users.values())
            return 200, f"<h1>Usuarios</h1><table><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>", {}
        if parts[:1] != ["users"]:
            return 404, {"error": "route_not_found", "path": path}, {}
        if self.headers.get("Authorization") != f"Bearer {TOKEN}":
            return 401, {"error": "unauthorized"}, {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
        with api.lock:
            return self.users(api, method, parts[1:], query, body)

    def users(self, api: FakeApi, method: str, rest: list[str], query: dict[str, str],
              body: Any) -> Reply:
        if not rest and method == "GET":
            page, size = int(query.get("page", "1")), int(query.get("size", "10"))
            if page < 1 or not 1 <= size <= 100:
                return 400, {"error": "invalid_pagination"}, {}
            rows = [u for u in api.users.values() if query.get("role") in (None, u["role"])]
            items = rows[(page - 1) * size:page * size]
            return 200, {"items": items, "page": page, "size": size, "total": len(rows)}, {}
        if not rest and method == "POST":
            if errors := user_errors(body, partial=False):
                return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}
        user_id = int(rest[0])
        if (current := api.users.get(user_id)) is None:
            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}
        return 200, api.users[user_id], {}


@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---


def build_session(retries: int | None) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    if retries is not None:
        policy = Retry(total=retries, status_forcelist=(502, 503, 504), backoff_factor=0.01,
                       allowed_methods=frozenset({"GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "DELETE"}))
        adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=policy)
        session.mount("http://", adapter)
        session.mount("https://", adapter)
    return session


def probe_flaky(base: str, retries: int | None) -> int | str:
    with build_session(retries) as session:
        try:
            return session.get(f"{base}/flaky", timeout=2).status_code
        except requests.exceptions.RetryError:
            return "RetryError"


def run_self_tests() -> None:
    cases: list[tuple[int | None, int, int | str]] = [
        (None, 1, 503),
        (1, 2, "RetryError"),
        (2, 3, 200),
        (5, 3, 200),
    ]
    for retries, expected_calls, expected_result in cases:
        with running_api() as api:  # API nueva: /flaky vuelve a fallar 2 veces
            result = probe_flaky(api.base_url, retries)
            calls = 2 - api.flaky_left
        print(f"retries={retries!s:<4} -> llamadas={calls} resultado={result}")
        assert (calls, result) == (expected_calls, expected_result)
    print("Ejercicio 11.3: todas las pruebas pasaron.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_self_tests()
```

Salida:

```text
retries=None -> llamadas=1 resultado=503
retries=1    -> llamadas=2 resultado=RetryError
retries=2    -> llamadas=3 resultado=200
retries=5    -> llamadas=3 resultado=200
Ejercicio 11.3: todas las pruebas pasaron.
```

#### Ejercicio 11.4: Consultas concurrentes con límite usando `httpx.AsyncClient`

**Enunciado**

Escribe `fetch_names(base, ids, limit) -> tuple[dict[int, str | None], int]`:

- Consulta `GET /users/{id}` para cada id **concurrentemente**, con un `asyncio.Semaphore(limit)`.
- Devuelve un diccionario `{id: nombre}` (con `None` si la respuesta es `404`) y el **máximo de peticiones simultáneas** que hubo en vuelo, para demostrar que el límite se respeta.
- Cualquier otro código de error debe lanzar `httpx.HTTPStatusError`.

Para que la concurrencia sea observable, cada petición, antes de consultar al usuario, llama a `GET /slow?delay=0.1`.

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| `ids` | `limit` | Diccionario devuelto | Máximo en vuelo |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[1, 2, 3, 99]` | `2` | `{1: "Ana", 2: "Luis", 3: "Eva", 99: None}` | `2` |
| `[1, 2, 3, 99]` | `4` | igual | `4` |
| `[]` | `3` | `{}` | `0` |

**Solución comentada**

```python
import asyncio

            i: {"id": i, "name": n, "email": f"{n.lower()}@qa.io", "role": r, "active": a}
            for i, (n, r, a) in enumerate(seed, start=1)}
        self.next_id, self.flaky_left, self.connections = 4, 2, 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}"

    def process_request(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:

        super().process_request(request, client_address)

    def handle_error(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:

class FakeApiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

                    and body.get("password") == "secret":
                cookie = {"Set-Cookie": f"session={TOKEN}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}
                return 200, {"token": TOKEN, "expires_in": 3600}, cookie
            return 401, {"error": "invalid_credentials"}, {}
        if parts == ["app", "users"]:

            with api.lock:

            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}

            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}

@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---


async def fetch_names(base: str, ids: list[int],
                      limit: int) -> tuple[dict[int, str | None], int]:
    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(limit)
    in_flight = 0
    max_in_flight = 0

    async def fetch_one(client: httpx.AsyncClient, user_id: int) -> tuple[int, str | None]:
        nonlocal in_flight, max_in_flight  # Módulo 4: modificar variables del ámbito envolvente
        async with semaphore:
            in_flight += 1
            max_in_flight = max(max_in_flight, in_flight)
            try:
                await client.get("/slow", params={"delay": 0.1})
                response = await client.get(f"/users/{user_id}")
            finally:
                in_flight -= 1
        if response.status_code == 404:
            return user_id, None
        response.raise_for_status()
        name: str = response.json()["name"]
        return user_id, name

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=base, headers=headers, timeout=5.0) as client:
        pairs = await asyncio.gather(*(fetch_one(client, user_id) for user_id in ids))
    return dict(pairs), max_in_flight


async def run_self_tests() -> None:
    expected = {1: "Ana", 2: "Luis", 3: "Eva", 99: None}
    with running_api() as api:
        names, peak = await fetch_names(api.base_url, [1, 2, 3, 99], limit=2)
        assert (names, peak) == (expected, 2), (names, peak)
        names, peak = await fetch_names(api.base_url, [1, 2, 3, 99], limit=4)
        assert (names, peak) == (expected, 4), (names, peak)
        assert await fetch_names(api.base_url, [], limit=3) == ({}, 0)
    print("Ejercicio 11.4: todas las pruebas pasaron.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_self_tests())
```

#### Ejercicio 11.5: Pruebas unitarias de un servicio con `httpx.MockTransport`

**Enunciado**

Este ejercicio **no** usa la API falsa: el objetivo es probar el código del cliente sin ningún servidor. Implementa la clase `UserService` con un método `get_user(user_id) -> dict[str, Any]` que, usando un `httpx.Client` recibido en el constructor:

| Respuesta del servidor | Comportamiento de `get_user` |
| --- | --- |
| `200` con JSON válido | Devuelve el diccionario |
| `404` | Lanza `UserNotFoundError` |
| `401` / `403` | Lanza `AuthError` |
| `5xx` | **Reintenta una sola vez**; si vuelve a fallar, lanza `ServiceUnavailableError` |
| `200` con un cuerpo que no es JSON | Lanza `ApiContractMismatchError` |

Escribe un `MockTransport` cuyo comportamiento dependa del id solicitado y que registre cuántas peticiones recibe.

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| `user_id` (comportamiento simulado) | Resultado | Peticiones enviadas |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1` (200) | `{"id": 1, "name": "Ana"}` | 1 |
| `2` (404) | `UserNotFoundError` | 1 |
| `3` (401) | `AuthError` | 1 |
| `4` (503 y luego 200) | `{"id": 4, "name": "Recuperado"}` | 2 |
| `5` (503 siempre) | `ServiceUnavailableError` | 2 |
| `6` (200 con HTML) | `ApiContractMismatchError` | 1 |

**Solución comentada**

```python
import json
from collections import Counter
from typing import Any

import httpx


class UserNotFoundError(Exception):
    pass


class AuthError(Exception):
    pass


class ServiceUnavailableError(Exception):
    pass


class ApiContractMismatchError(Exception):
    pass


class UserService:
    def __init__(self, client: httpx.Client) -> None:
        self.client = client  # Inyección de dependencias: las pruebas pasan un cliente simulado

    def get_user(self, user_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        response = self.client.get(f"/users/{user_id}")
        if response.status_code >= 500:  # Un único reintento ante errores del servidor
            response = self.client.get(f"/users/{user_id}")
            if response.status_code >= 500:
                raise ServiceUnavailableError(f"{response.status_code} tras 1 reintento")
        if response.status_code == 404:
            raise UserNotFoundError(user_id)
        if response.status_code in (401, 403):
            raise AuthError(response.status_code)
        response.raise_for_status()
        try:
            data: dict[str, Any] = response.json()
        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
            raise ApiContractMismatchError(f"cuerpo no JSON: {response.text[:30]!r}") from error
        return data


calls: Counter[int] = Counter()


def backend(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
    user_id = int(request.url.path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
    calls[user_id] += 1
    match user_id:
        case 1:
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"id": 1, "name": "Ana"})
        case 2:
            return httpx.Response(404, json={"error": "not_found"})
        case 3:
            return httpx.Response(401, json={"error": "unauthorized"})
        case 4 if calls[4] == 1:
            return httpx.Response(503)
        case 4:
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"id": 4, "name": "Recuperado"})
        case 5:
            return httpx.Response(503)
        case _:
            return httpx.Response(200, text="<html>Mantenimiento</html>")


def run_self_tests() -> None:
    client = httpx.Client(base_url="https://api.example.test",
                          transport=httpx.MockTransport(backend))
    service = UserService(client)
    assert service.get_user(1) == {"id": 1, "name": "Ana"}
    assert service.get_user(4) == {"id": 4, "name": "Recuperado"}
    expected_errors: dict[int, type[Exception]] = {
        2: UserNotFoundError, 3: AuthError, 5: ServiceUnavailableError,
        6: ApiContractMismatchError,
    }
    for user_id, error_type in expected_errors.items():
        try:
            service.get_user(user_id)
        except error_type:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"user_id={user_id}: se esperaba {error_type.__name__}")
    assert calls == Counter({1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1, 4: 2, 5: 2, 6: 1}), calls
    client.close()
    print("Ejercicio 11.5: todas las pruebas pasaron sin abrir conexiones de red.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_self_tests()
```

#### Ejercicio 11.6: Validar una página de usuarios con `TypedDict` y `TypeIs`

**Enunciado**

Sin pydantic, escribe una validación manual de la respuesta de `GET /users`:

- `UserPayload` y `UsersPage` como `TypedDict`, con `role` de tipo `Literal`.
- `page_mismatches(raw: object) -> list[str]`: lista de diferencias con el contrato. `page`, `size` y `total` deben ser `int` exactos (no `bool` ni `str`); `items` debe ser una lista; y cada elemento debe cumplir `UserPayload`, con su posición en el mensaje (`"items[1]: ..."`).
- `is_users_page(raw: object) -> TypeIs[UsersPage]`.
- `parse_users_page(raw: object, endpoint: str) -> list[UserPayload]`: devuelve los usuarios o lanza `ApiContractMismatchError` (Módulo 6) con todas las diferencias.

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| Entrada | Salida de `page_mismatches` |
| --- | --- |
| Respuesta real de `GET /users` | `[]` |
| Igual, pero `items[1].role = "auditor"` | `["items[1]: 'role' inválido: 'auditor'"]` |
| Igual, pero `total = "3"` y sin `items[0].email` | `["'total' debe ser int, llegó str", "items[0]: falta 'email'"]` |
| `[1, 2]` (una lista en vez de un objeto) | `["se esperaba un objeto JSON y llegó list"]` |
| `{"page": 1, "size": 10, "total": 0, "items": "x"}` | `["'items' debe ser una lista, llegó str"]` |

**Solución comentada**

```python
import copy
import html
import json
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any, Literal, TypedDict, TypeIs, cast
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import requests

# --- API falsa compacta (versión completa explicada en 11.1.2): puedes saltarte este tramo ---
TOKEN = "token-123"
ROLES = ("admin", "tester", "viewer")
Reply = tuple[int, object, dict[str, str]]  # (código, cuerpo JSON o HTML, cabeceras extra)


class FakeApi(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeApiHandler)
        seed = [("Ana", "admin", True), ("Luis", "tester", True), ("Eva", "viewer", False)]
        self.users: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {
            i: {"id": i, "name": n, "email": f"{n.lower()}@qa.io", "role": r, "active": a}
            for i, (n, r, a) in enumerate(seed, start=1)}
        self.next_id, self.flaky_left, self.connections = 4, 2, 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}"

    def process_request(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.connections += 1
        super().process_request(request, client_address)

    def handle_error(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Silencia clientes que cortan la conexión (por ejemplo, por timeout)


def user_errors(body: Any, partial: bool) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return ["body"]
    errors = [] if partial else [f for f in ("name", "email", "role") if f not in body]
    errors += ["role"] if body.get("role", ROLES[0]) not in ROLES else []
    errors += ["email"] if "@" not in str(body.get("email", "@")) else []
    return errors + sorted(set(body) - {"name", "email", "role", "active"})


class FakeApiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"  # Conexiones persistentes (keep-alive)

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Sin log por petición en stderr

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # Todos los métodos HTTP pasan por aquí (ver la última línea)
        url = urlparse(self.path)
        size = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        query = {key: values[0] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query).items()}
        try:
            body: Any = json.loads(self.rfile.read(size)) if size else None
            status, payload, headers = self.route(cast(FakeApi, self.server), url.path, query, body)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            status, payload, headers = 400, {"error": "invalid_json"}, {}
        is_html = isinstance(payload, str)
        text = str(payload) if is_html else "" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload)
        data = text.encode()
        headers = {"Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" if is_html else "application/json",
                   "Content-Length": str(len(data))} | headers
        self.send_response(status)
        for key, value in headers.items():
            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_GET

    def route(self, api: FakeApi, path: str, query: dict[str, str], body: Any) -> Reply:
        parts, method = [p for p in path.split("/") if p], self.command
        if parts == ["health"]:
            return 200, {"status": "ok"}, {}
        if parts == ["slow"]:
            time.sleep(delay := float(query.get("delay", "0.2")))
            return 200, {"waited": delay}, {}
        if parts == ["flaky"]:
            with api.lock:
                api.flaky_left -= 1
                if api.flaky_left >= 0:
                    return 503, {"error": "unavailable"}, {"Retry-After": "0"}
            return 200, {"status": "recovered"}, {}
        if parts == ["login"] and method == "POST":
            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("username") == "admin" \
                    and body.get("password") == "secret":
                cookie = {"Set-Cookie": f"session={TOKEN}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}
                return 200, {"token": TOKEN, "expires_in": 3600}, cookie
            return 401, {"error": "invalid_credentials"}, {}
        if parts == ["app", "users"]:
            if f"session={TOKEN}" not in (self.headers.get("Cookie") or ""):
                return 401, "<h1>Inicia sesión</h1>", {}
            with api.lock:
                rows = "".join(f"<tr data-testid='user-{u['id']}'><td>{html.escape(u['name'])}</td>"
                               f"<td>{html.escape(u['email'])}</td><td>{u['role']}</td></tr>"
                               for u in api.users.values())
            return 200, f"<h1>Usuarios</h1><table><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>", {}
        if parts[:1] != ["users"]:
            return 404, {"error": "route_not_found", "path": path}, {}
        if self.headers.get("Authorization") != f"Bearer {TOKEN}":
            return 401, {"error": "unauthorized"}, {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
        with api.lock:
            return self.users(api, method, parts[1:], query, body)

    def users(self, api: FakeApi, method: str, rest: list[str], query: dict[str, str],
              body: Any) -> Reply:
        if not rest and method == "GET":
            page, size = int(query.get("page", "1")), int(query.get("size", "10"))
            if page < 1 or not 1 <= size <= 100:
                return 400, {"error": "invalid_pagination"}, {}
            rows = [u for u in api.users.values() if query.get("role") in (None, u["role"])]
            items = rows[(page - 1) * size:page * size]
            return 200, {"items": items, "page": page, "size": size, "total": len(rows)}, {}
        if not rest and method == "POST":
            if errors := user_errors(body, partial=False):
                return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}
        user_id = int(rest[0])
        if (current := api.users.get(user_id)) is None:
            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}
        return 200, api.users[user_id], {}


@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---

VALID_ROLES: tuple[str, ...] = ("admin", "tester", "viewer")


class UserPayload(TypedDict):
    id: int
    name: str
    email: str
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]
    active: bool


class UsersPage(TypedDict):
    items: list[UserPayload]
    page: int
    size: int
    total: int


class AutomationFrameworkError(Exception):
    """Raíz de los errores del framework (Módulo 6)."""


class ApiContractMismatchError(AutomationFrameworkError):
    def __init__(self, endpoint: str, *, mismatches: list[str], received: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.endpoint = endpoint
        self.mismatches = mismatches
        self.received = received
        super().__init__(
            f"Contrato roto en {endpoint}: {len(mismatches)} diferencia(s): {'; '.join(mismatches)}"
        )


def type_problem(name: str, value: object, expected: type) -> list[str]:
    if type(value) is expected:  # 'type is' exacto: True no pasa por int
        return []
    return [f"'{name}' debe ser {expected.__name__}, llegó {type(value).__name__}"]


def user_mismatches(value: object) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return [f"se esperaba un objeto y llegó {type(value).__name__}"]
    problems: list[str] = []
    for key, expected in {"id": int, "name": str, "email": str, "active": bool}.items():
        if key not in value:
            problems.append(f"falta '{key}'")
        else:
            problems += type_problem(key, value[key], expected)
    if value.get("role") not in VALID_ROLES:
        problems.append(f"'role' inválido: {value.get('role')!r}")
    return problems


def page_mismatches(raw: object) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return [f"se esperaba un objeto JSON y llegó {type(raw).__name__}"]
    problems: list[str] = []
    for key in ("page", "size", "total"):
        problems += type_problem(key, raw.get(key), int)
    items = raw.get("items")
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        return problems + [f"'items' debe ser una lista, llegó {type(items).__name__}"]
    for index, item in enumerate(items):
        problems += [f"items[{index}]: {problem}" for problem in user_mismatches(item)]
    return problems


def is_users_page(raw: object) -> TypeIs[UsersPage]:
    return not page_mismatches(raw)


def parse_users_page(raw: object, endpoint: str) -> list[UserPayload]:
    if is_users_page(raw):
        return raw["items"]  # mypy: raw es UsersPage en esta rama
    received = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {"value": raw}
    raise ApiContractMismatchError(endpoint, mismatches=page_mismatches(raw), received=received)


def run_self_tests() -> None:
    with running_api() as api:
        real: dict[str, Any] = requests.get(f"{api.base_url}/users", timeout=5,
                                            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"}).json()
    assert page_mismatches(real) == []
    assert [user["name"] for user in parse_users_page(real, "GET /users")] == ["Ana", "Luis", "Eva"]

    auditor = copy.deepcopy(real)  # Copia profunda (Módulo 3): no tocar 'real'
    auditor["items"][1]["role"] = "auditor"
    assert page_mismatches(auditor) == ["items[1]: 'role' inválido: 'auditor'"]

    several = copy.deepcopy(real)
    several["total"] = "3"
    del several["items"][0]["email"]
    assert page_mismatches(several) == [
        "'total' debe ser int, llegó str", "items[0]: falta 'email'"]

    assert page_mismatches([1, 2]) == ["se esperaba un objeto JSON y llegó list"]
    assert page_mismatches({"page": 1, "size": 10, "total": 0, "items": "x"}) == [
        "'items' debe ser una lista, llegó str"]

    try:
        parse_users_page(several, "GET /users")
    except ApiContractMismatchError as error:
        assert error.mismatches == page_mismatches(several)
        print(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Se esperaba ApiContractMismatchError")
    print("Ejercicio 11.6: todas las pruebas pasaron.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_self_tests()
```

Salida:

```text
Contrato roto en GET /users: 2 diferencia(s): 'total' debe ser int, llegó str; items[0]: falta 'email'
Ejercicio 11.6: todas las pruebas pasaron.
```

#### Ejercicio 11.7: Recorrer todas las páginas validando el contrato con pydantic

**Enunciado**

1. Define los modelos de contrato `User` y `UsersPage` con `ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)`.
2. Escribe `contract_locations(payload: object) -> list[str]`, que valida una página y devuelve la lista de **ubicaciones** de los errores (`"items.0.id"`, `"total"`...), vacía si es válida.
3. Escribe `collect_all_users(session, base, size) -> list[User]`, que recorra la paginación de `GET /users` validando **cada** página con `UsersPage` y se detenga cuando haya reunido `total` usuarios. Si una página no cumple el contrato, debe lanzar `ApiContractMismatchError` con el número de página en el endpoint (`"GET /users?page=2"`).

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| Variante de una página real | `contract_locations` |
| --- | --- |
| Sin cambios | `[]` |
| `items[0]` con un campo extra `phone` | `["items.0.phone"]` |
| `items[0].id` como texto `"1"` | `["items.0.id"]` |
| Sin la clave `total` | `["total"]` |
| `size` igual a `0` | `["size"]` |

| Llamada | Resultado |
| --- | --- |
| `collect_all_users(session, base, size=1)` con 5 usuarios en la API | 5 modelos `User` con ids `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` |
| `collect_all_users(session, base, size=2)` | Los mismos 5 usuarios (3 páginas) |

**Solución comentada**

```python

            return 200, f"<h1>Usuarios</h1><table><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>", {}
        if parts[:1] != ["users"]:

    def users(self, api: FakeApi, method: str, rest: list[str], query: dict[str, str],
              body: Any) -> Reply:
        if not rest and method == "GET":
            page, size = int(query.get("page", "1")), int(query.get("size", "10"))
            if page < 1 or not 1 <= size <= 100:
                return 400, {"error": "invalid_pagination"}, {}
            rows = [u for u in api.users.values() if query.get("role") in (None, u["role"])]
            items = rows[(page - 1) * size:page * size]
            return 200, {"items": items, "page": page, "size": size, "total": len(rows)}, {}
        if not rest and method == "POST":
            if errors := user_errors(body, partial=False):
                return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}
        user_id = int(rest[0])
        if (current := api.users.get(user_id)) is None:
            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}
        return 200, api.users[user_id], {}


@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---


class ApiContractMismatchError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, endpoint: str, *, mismatches: list[str], received: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.endpoint = endpoint
        self.mismatches = mismatches
        self.received = received
        super().__init__(f"Contrato roto en {endpoint}: {'; '.join(mismatches)}")


class User(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    id: int = Field(gt=0)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1)
    email: str
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]
    active: bool


class UsersPage(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    items: list[User]
    page: int = Field(ge=1)
    size: int = Field(ge=1, le=100)
    total: int = Field(ge=0)


def contract_locations(payload: object) -> list[str]:
    try:
        UsersPage.model_validate(payload)
    except ValidationError as error:
        return [".".join(str(part) for part in err["loc"]) for err in error.errors()]
    return []


def collect_all_users(session: requests.Session, base: str, size: int) -> list[User]:
    users: list[User] = []
    page_number = 1
    while True:
        raw = session.get(f"{base}/users", params={"page": page_number, "size": size},
                          timeout=5).json()
        try:
            page = UsersPage.model_validate(raw)
        except ValidationError as error:
            mismatches = [f"{'.'.join(map(str, err['loc']))}: {err['msg']}"
                          for err in error.errors()]
            raise ApiContractMismatchError(f"GET /users?page={page_number}",
                                           mismatches=mismatches, received=raw) from error
        users.extend(page.items)
        if len(users) >= page.total or not page.items:
            return users
        page_number += 1


def run_self_tests() -> None:
    with running_api() as api, requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"
        for name in ("Uno", "Dos"):  # 3 iniciales + 2 nuevos = 5 usuarios
            session.post(f"{api.base_url}/users", timeout=5,
                         json={"name": name, "email": f"{name.lower()}@qa.io", "role": "viewer"})
        real: dict[str, Any] = session.get(f"{api.base_url}/users", timeout=5).json()

        assert [user.id for user in collect_all_users(session, api.base_url, size=1)] == [
            1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        assert collect_all_users(session, api.base_url, size=2) == collect_all_users(
            session, api.base_url, size=5)

    variants: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any], list[str]]] = []
    variants.append(("sin cambios", copy.deepcopy(real), []))
    extra = copy.deepcopy(real)
    extra["items"][0]["phone"] = "600"
    variants.append(("campo extra", extra, ["items.0.phone"]))
    text_id = copy.deepcopy(real)
    text_id["items"][0]["id"] = "1"
    variants.append(("id como texto", text_id, ["items.0.id"]))
    no_total = copy.deepcopy(real)
    del no_total["total"]
    variants.append(("sin total", no_total, ["total"]))
    zero_size = copy.deepcopy(real) | {"size": 0}
    variants.append(("size 0", zero_size, ["size"]))
    for label, payload, expected in variants:
        locations = contract_locations(payload)
        print(f"{label:<14} -> {locations}")
        assert locations == expected
    print("Ejercicio 11.7: todas las pruebas pasaron.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_self_tests()
```

Salida:

```text
sin cambios    -> []
campo extra    -> ['items.0.phone']
id como texto  -> ['items.0.id']
sin total      -> ['total']
size 0         -> ['size']
Ejercicio 11.7: todas las pruebas pasaron.
```

#### Ejercicio 11.8: Clasificar cambios de contrato como compatibles o incompatibles

**Enunciado**

Escribe `classify_changes(approved: type[BaseModel], proposed: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, list[str]]` que compare los JSON Schema de dos versiones de un modelo **de respuesta** y devuelva `{"breaking": [...], "compatible": [...]}` con estas reglas:

| Cambio | Clasificación | Motivo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Campo añadido | `compatible` | Los clientes que no lo conocen lo ignoran |
| Campo eliminado | `breaking` | Un cliente que lo leía fallará |
| Cambio de tipo | `breaking` | Un cliente que esperaba un número recibe un texto |
| Campo obligatorio que pasa a opcional | `breaking` | Un cliente que contaba con él puede no recibirlo |
| Campo opcional que pasa a obligatorio | `compatible` | Los clientes reciben el dato siempre |
| Nuevos valores en un enum | `breaking` | Un cliente con un `match` exhaustivo no sabe tratarlos |

Cada cambio se describe con un texto como `"eliminado: active"` o `"tipo: id integer -> string"`.

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| Versión propuesta respecto a `UserV1` | `breaking` | `compatible` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Idéntica | `[]` | `[]` |
| Añade `nickname: str \| None = None` | `[]` | `["añadido: nickname"]` |
| Elimina `active` | `["eliminado: active"]` | `[]` |
| `id` pasa a `str` | `["tipo: id integer -> string"]` | `[]` |
| `email` pasa a opcional | `["ahora opcional: email"]` | `[]` |
| `role` admite `"auditor"` | `["enum ampliado: role +['auditor']"]` | `[]` |

**Solución comentada**

```python
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel


class UserV1(BaseModel):
    id: int
    email: str
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]
    active: bool


class Same(UserV1):
    pass


class AddsNickname(UserV1):
    nickname: str | None = None


class RemovesActive(BaseModel):
    id: int
    email: str
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]


class IdAsString(BaseModel):
    id: str
    email: str
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]
    active: bool


class OptionalEmail(BaseModel):
    id: int
    email: str | None = None
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]
    active: bool


class WiderRole(BaseModel):
    id: int
    email: str
    role: Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer", "auditor"]
    active: bool


def field_types(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
    """Tipos JSON de un campo; los opcionales aparecen como anyOf [..., {'type': 'null'}]."""
    if "anyOf" in spec:
        return {str(option.get("type")) for option in spec["anyOf"]} - {"null"}
    return {str(spec.get("type"))}


def classify_changes(approved: type[BaseModel],
                     proposed: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    old, new = approved.model_json_schema(), proposed.model_json_schema()
    old_props: dict[str, Any] = old["properties"]
    new_props: dict[str, Any] = new["properties"]
    old_required, new_required = set(old.get("required", [])), set(new.get("required", []))
    result: dict[str, list[str]] = {"breaking": [], "compatible": []}

    for name in sorted(new_props.keys() - old_props.keys()):
        result["compatible"].append(f"añadido: {name}")
    for name in sorted(old_props.keys() - new_props.keys()):
        result["breaking"].append(f"eliminado: {name}")
    for name in sorted(old_props.keys() & new_props.keys()):
        before, after = old_props[name], new_props[name]
        if field_types(before) != field_types(after):
            old_t, new_t = "|".join(sorted(field_types(before))), "|".join(
                sorted(field_types(after)))
            result["breaking"].append(f"tipo: {name} {old_t} -> {new_t}")
        if name in old_required and name not in new_required:
            result["breaking"].append(f"ahora opcional: {name}")
        if name not in old_required and name in new_required:
            result["compatible"].append(f"ahora obligatorio: {name}")
        added_values = [v for v in after.get("enum", []) if v not in before.get("enum", [])]
        if added_values:
            result["breaking"].append(f"enum ampliado: {name} +{added_values}")
    return result


def run_self_tests() -> None:
    cases: list[tuple[type[BaseModel], list[str], list[str]]] = [
        (Same, [], []),
        (AddsNickname, [], ["añadido: nickname"]),
        (RemovesActive, ["eliminado: active"], []),
        (IdAsString, ["tipo: id integer -> string"], []),
        (OptionalEmail, ["ahora opcional: email"], []),
        (WiderRole, ["enum ampliado: role +['auditor']"], []),
    ]
    for proposed, breaking, compatible in cases:
        result = classify_changes(UserV1, proposed)
        print(f"{proposed.__name__:<14} -> {result}")
        assert result == {"breaking": breaking, "compatible": compatible}, result
    print("Ejercicio 11.8: todas las pruebas pasaron.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_self_tests()
```

Salida:

```text
Same           -> {'breaking': [], 'compatible': []}
AddsNickname   -> {'breaking': [], 'compatible': ['añadido: nickname']}
RemovesActive  -> {'breaking': ['eliminado: active'], 'compatible': []}
IdAsString     -> {'breaking': ['tipo: id integer -> string'], 'compatible': []}
OptionalEmail  -> {'breaking': ['ahora opcional: email'], 'compatible': []}
WiderRole      -> {'breaking': ["enum ampliado: role +['auditor']"], 'compatible': []}
Ejercicio 11.8: todas las pruebas pasaron.
```

En un pipeline, `classify_changes` se ejecuta comparando el *snapshot* aprobado con el modelo actual: los cambios `compatible` se notifican y los `breaking` hacen fallar la prueba hasta que alguien los apruebe y actualice el *snapshot*.

#### Ejercicio 11.9: API Object con paginación perezosa y suite de pytest

**Enunciado**

Amplía el patrón de la sección 11.7 con un `UsersApi` que ofrezca:

- `iter_all(size) -> Iterator[User]`: un **generador** (Módulo 8) que recorre la paginación y entrega los usuarios uno a uno, pidiendo cada página **solo cuando hace falta**.
- `find_by_role(role) -> list[User]`, usando el filtro `?role=` de la API.
- `create(name, email, role) -> User`, `deactivate(user_id) -> User` (con `PATCH`) y `delete(user_id) -> None`.

Escribe una suite de pytest con:

- Una *fixture* `user_factory` que cree usuarios y los elimine todos en el *teardown*.
- Una prueba que demuestre que `iter_all` es perezoso: tomar solo el primer usuario con `itertools.islice` debe provocar **una sola** petición HTTP. Cuenta las respuestas con un *hook* de `requests`.

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| Prueba | Verificación |
| --- | --- |
| `test_iter_all_matches_total` | `iter_all(size=2)` produce tantos usuarios como `total`, sin repetidos |
| `test_iter_all_is_lazy` | `islice(iter_all(size=1), 1)` envía exactamente 1 petición |
| `test_find_by_role` | Con 2 *testers* nuevos, `find_by_role("tester")` devuelve 3 (incluido Luis), todos con rol `tester` |
| `test_deactivate` | El usuario queda con `active == False` y el cambio persiste en un `GET` posterior |
| `test_factory_leaves_no_residue` | Al final, la API vuelve a tener 3 usuarios |

**Solución comentada**

```python
import html
import itertools
import json
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any, Literal, cast
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import pytest
import requests
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

# --- API falsa compacta (versión completa explicada en 11.1.2): puedes saltarte este tramo ---
TOKEN = "token-123"
ROLES = ("admin", "tester", "viewer")
Reply = tuple[int, object, dict[str, str]]  # (código, cuerpo JSON o HTML, cabeceras extra)


class FakeApi(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeApiHandler)
        seed = [("Ana", "admin", True), ("Luis", "tester", True), ("Eva", "viewer", False)]
        self.users: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {
            i: {"id": i, "name": n, "email": f"{n.lower()}@qa.io", "role": r, "active": a}
            for i, (n, r, a) in enumerate(seed, start=1)}
        self.next_id, self.flaky_left, self.connections = 4, 2, 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}"

    def process_request(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.connections += 1
        super().process_request(request, client_address)

    def handle_error(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Silencia clientes que cortan la conexión (por ejemplo, por timeout)


def user_errors(body: Any, partial: bool) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return ["body"]
    errors = [] if partial else [f for f in ("name", "email", "role") if f not in body]
    errors += ["role"] if body.get("role", ROLES[0]) not in ROLES else []
    errors += ["email"] if "@" not in str(body.get("email", "@")) else []
    return errors + sorted(set(body) - {"name", "email", "role", "active"})


class FakeApiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"  # Conexiones persistentes (keep-alive)

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Sin log por petición en stderr

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # Todos los métodos HTTP pasan por aquí (ver la última línea)
        url = urlparse(self.path)
        size = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        query = {key: values[0] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query).items()}
        try:
            body: Any = json.loads(self.rfile.read(size)) if size else None
            status, payload, headers = self.route(cast(FakeApi, self.server), url.path, query, body)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            status, payload, headers = 400, {"error": "invalid_json"}, {}
        is_html = isinstance(payload, str)
        text = str(payload) if is_html else "" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload)
        data = text.encode()
        headers = {"Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" if is_html else "application/json",
                   "Content-Length": str(len(data))} | headers
        self.send_response(status)
        for key, value in headers.items():
            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_GET

    def route(self, api: FakeApi, path: str, query: dict[str, str], body: Any) -> Reply:
        parts, method = [p for p in path.split("/") if p], self.command
        if parts == ["health"]:
            return 200, {"status": "ok"}, {}
        if parts == ["slow"]:
            time.sleep(delay := float(query.get("delay", "0.2")))
            return 200, {"waited": delay}, {}
        if parts == ["flaky"]:
            with api.lock:
                api.flaky_left -= 1
                if api.flaky_left >= 0:
                    return 503, {"error": "unavailable"}, {"Retry-After": "0"}
            return 200, {"status": "recovered"}, {}
        if parts == ["login"] and method == "POST":
            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("username") == "admin" \
                    and body.get("password") == "secret":
                cookie = {"Set-Cookie": f"session={TOKEN}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}
                return 200, {"token": TOKEN, "expires_in": 3600}, cookie
            return 401, {"error": "invalid_credentials"}, {}
        if parts == ["app", "users"]:
            if f"session={TOKEN}" not in (self.headers.get("Cookie") or ""):
                return 401, "<h1>Inicia sesión</h1>", {}
            with api.lock:
                rows = "".join(f"<tr data-testid='user-{u['id']}'><td>{html.escape(u['name'])}</td>"
                               f"<td>{html.escape(u['email'])}</td><td>{u['role']}</td></tr>"
                               for u in api.users.values())
            return 200, f"<h1>Usuarios</h1><table><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>", {}
        if parts[:1] != ["users"]:
            return 404, {"error": "route_not_found", "path": path}, {}
        if self.headers.get("Authorization") != f"Bearer {TOKEN}":
            return 401, {"error": "unauthorized"}, {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
        with api.lock:
            return self.users(api, method, parts[1:], query, body)

    def users(self, api: FakeApi, method: str, rest: list[str], query: dict[str, str],
              body: Any) -> Reply:
        if not rest and method == "GET":
            page, size = int(query.get("page", "1")), int(query.get("size", "10"))
            if page < 1 or not 1 <= size <= 100:
                return 400, {"error": "invalid_pagination"}, {}
            rows = [u for u in api.users.values() if query.get("role") in (None, u["role"])]
            items = rows[(page - 1) * size:page * size]
            return 200, {"items": items, "page": page, "size": size, "total": len(rows)}, {}
        if not rest and method == "POST":
            if errors := user_errors(body, partial=False):
                return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}
        user_id = int(rest[0])
        if (current := api.users.get(user_id)) is None:
            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}
        return 200, api.users[user_id], {}


@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---

Role = Literal["admin", "tester", "viewer"]


class User(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    id: int
    name: str
    email: str
    role: Role
    active: bool


class UsersPage(BaseModel):
    items: list[User]
    page: int
    size: int
    total: int


class UsersApi:
    def __init__(self, base_url: str, session: requests.Session) -> None:
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.session = session

    def _send(self, method: str, path: str, expected: int, **kwargs: Any) -> requests.Response:
        response = self.session.request(method, f"{self.base_url}{path}", timeout=5, **kwargs)
        assert response.status_code == expected, (
            f"{method} {path}: se esperaba {expected} y llegó {response.status_code}: "
            f"{response.text}")
        return response

    def _page(self, page: int, size: int, role: Role | None = None) -> UsersPage:
        params: dict[str, str | int] = {"page": page, "size": size}
        if role is not None:
            params["role"] = role
        return UsersPage.model_validate_json(self._send("GET", "/users", 200,
                                                        params=params).text)

    def iter_all(self, size: int = 10, role: Role | None = None) -> Iterator[User]:
        for page_number in itertools.count(start=1):  # 1, 2, 3... sin fin
            page = self._page(page_number, size, role)
            yield from page.items  # Se suspende aquí hasta que piden el siguiente usuario
            if page_number * size >= page.total:
                return

    def find_by_role(self, role: Role) -> list[User]:
        return list(self.iter_all(size=50, role=role))

    def create(self, name: str, email: str, role: Role) -> User:
        body = {"name": name, "email": email, "role": role}
        return User.model_validate_json(self._send("POST", "/users", 201, json=body).text)

    def get(self, user_id: int) -> User:
        return User.model_validate_json(self._send("GET", f"/users/{user_id}", 200).text)

    def deactivate(self, user_id: int) -> User:
        response = self._send("PATCH", f"/users/{user_id}", 200, json={"active": False})
        return User.model_validate_json(response.text)

    def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        self._send("DELETE", f"/users/{user_id}", 204)


UserFactory = Callable[..., User]


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def api_server() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    with running_api() as server:
        yield server


@pytest.fixture
def http() -> Iterator[requests.Session]:
    with requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"
        yield session


@pytest.fixture
def users_api(api_server: FakeApi, http: requests.Session) -> UsersApi:
    return UsersApi(api_server.base_url, http)


@pytest.fixture
def user_factory(users_api: UsersApi) -> Iterator[UserFactory]:
    created: list[User] = []

    def create(role: Role = "viewer") -> User:
        unique = time.perf_counter_ns()
        user = users_api.create(f"Fab {unique}", f"fab{unique}@qa.io", role)
        created.append(user)
        return user

    yield create
    for user in created:
        users_api.delete(user.id)


def test_iter_all_matches_total(users_api: UsersApi, user_factory: UserFactory) -> None:
    user_factory()
    user_factory()
    users = list(users_api.iter_all(size=2))
    ids = [user.id for user in users]
    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)) == users_api._page(1, 1).total == 5


def test_iter_all_is_lazy(users_api: UsersApi, http: requests.Session) -> None:
    responses: list[int] = []

    def count_response(response: requests.Response, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        responses.append(response.status_code)

    http.hooks["response"].append(count_response)
    first = list(itertools.islice(users_api.iter_all(size=1), 1))
    assert [user.name for user in first] == ["Ana"]
    assert responses == [200], "solo debía pedirse la primera página"


def test_find_by_role(users_api: UsersApi, user_factory: UserFactory) -> None:
    user_factory("tester")
    user_factory("tester")
    testers = users_api.find_by_role("tester")
    assert len(testers) == 3
    assert {user.role for user in testers} == {"tester"}


def test_deactivate(users_api: UsersApi, user_factory: UserFactory) -> None:
    user = user_factory()
    assert user.active is True
    assert users_api.deactivate(user.id).active is False
    assert users_api.get(user.id).active is False


def test_factory_leaves_no_residue(users_api: UsersApi) -> None:
    assert [user.name for user in users_api.iter_all()] == ["Ana", "Luis", "Eva"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "--no-header", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
                                  "-p", "no:asyncio", "-p", "no:playwright"]))
```

#### Ejercicio 11.10: Suite híbrida API + UI con Playwright

**Enunciado**

Escribe una suite de pytest con Playwright (sin el *plugin* `pytest-playwright`, con *fixtures* propias) que combine API y UI sobre la página `/app/users` de la API falsa:

- *Fixtures* de scope `module`: `api_server`, `playwright_instance`, `ui_browser` (Chromium sin ventana), `api_request` (un `APIRequestContext` que inicia sesión con `admin`/`secret`), `admin_token` y `auth_state` (el `storage_state` de `api_request`).
- *Fixture* `seeded_user` (scope `function`): crea un usuario único por API y lo elimina al terminar, aceptando `204` o `404` (la prueba pudo haberlo borrado ya).
- *Fixture* `ui_page`: un contexto de navegador nuevo con `auth_state` y su página; cierra el contexto al terminar.

Pruebas:

1. Un visitante sin sesión ve el título "Inicia sesión" y la página responde `401`.
2. Un usuario creado por API aparece en la tabla de la UI con su nombre y su email.
3. Un usuario borrado por API desaparece de la UI al recargar la página.
4. Las peticiones de `ui_page.request` usan la cookie de la sesión del navegador (`200` en `/app/users`).

**Entradas y salidas esperadas**

| Prueba | Resultado esperado |
| --- | --- |
| `test_anonymous_visitor_is_asked_to_log_in` | `PASSED` (`401` y título "Inicia sesión") |
| `test_user_created_by_api_is_listed` | `PASSED` (fila `user-<id>` con nombre y email) |
| `test_user_deleted_by_api_disappears` | `PASSED` (la fila tiene 0 coincidencias tras recargar) |
| `test_page_requests_share_session_cookie` | `PASSED` |

**Solución comentada**

```python
import html
import json
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any, cast
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import (
    APIRequestContext,
    Browser,
    Page,
    Playwright,
    StorageState,
    expect,
    sync_playwright,
)

# --- API falsa compacta (versión completa explicada en 11.1.2): puedes saltarte este tramo ---
TOKEN = "token-123"
ROLES = ("admin", "tester", "viewer")
Reply = tuple[int, object, dict[str, str]]  # (código, cuerpo JSON o HTML, cabeceras extra)


class FakeApi(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeApiHandler)
        seed = [("Ana", "admin", True), ("Luis", "tester", True), ("Eva", "viewer", False)]
        self.users: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {
            i: {"id": i, "name": n, "email": f"{n.lower()}@qa.io", "role": r, "active": a}
            for i, (n, r, a) in enumerate(seed, start=1)}
        self.next_id, self.flaky_left, self.connections = 4, 2, 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server_port}"

    def process_request(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.connections += 1
        super().process_request(request, client_address)

    def handle_error(self, request: Any, client_address: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Silencia clientes que cortan la conexión (por ejemplo, por timeout)


def user_errors(body: Any, partial: bool) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return ["body"]
    errors = [] if partial else [f for f in ("name", "email", "role") if f not in body]
    errors += ["role"] if body.get("role", ROLES[0]) not in ROLES else []
    errors += ["email"] if "@" not in str(body.get("email", "@")) else []
    return errors + sorted(set(body) - {"name", "email", "role", "active"})


class FakeApiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"  # Conexiones persistentes (keep-alive)

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        pass  # Sin log por petición en stderr

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # Todos los métodos HTTP pasan por aquí (ver la última línea)
        url = urlparse(self.path)
        size = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        query = {key: values[0] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query).items()}
        try:
            body: Any = json.loads(self.rfile.read(size)) if size else None
            status, payload, headers = self.route(cast(FakeApi, self.server), url.path, query, body)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            status, payload, headers = 400, {"error": "invalid_json"}, {}
        is_html = isinstance(payload, str)
        text = str(payload) if is_html else "" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload)
        data = text.encode()
        headers = {"Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" if is_html else "application/json",
                   "Content-Length": str(len(data))} | headers
        self.send_response(status)
        for key, value in headers.items():
            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_GET

    def route(self, api: FakeApi, path: str, query: dict[str, str], body: Any) -> Reply:
        parts, method = [p for p in path.split("/") if p], self.command
        if parts == ["health"]:
            return 200, {"status": "ok"}, {}
        if parts == ["slow"]:
            time.sleep(delay := float(query.get("delay", "0.2")))
            return 200, {"waited": delay}, {}
        if parts == ["flaky"]:
            with api.lock:
                api.flaky_left -= 1
                if api.flaky_left >= 0:
                    return 503, {"error": "unavailable"}, {"Retry-After": "0"}
            return 200, {"status": "recovered"}, {}
        if parts == ["login"] and method == "POST":
            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("username") == "admin" \
                    and body.get("password") == "secret":
                cookie = {"Set-Cookie": f"session={TOKEN}; Path=/; HttpOnly"}
                return 200, {"token": TOKEN, "expires_in": 3600}, cookie
            return 401, {"error": "invalid_credentials"}, {}
        if parts == ["app", "users"]:
            if f"session={TOKEN}" not in (self.headers.get("Cookie") or ""):
                return 401, "<h1>Inicia sesión</h1>", {}
            with api.lock:
                rows = "".join(f"<tr data-testid='user-{u['id']}'><td>{html.escape(u['name'])}</td>"
                               f"<td>{html.escape(u['email'])}</td><td>{u['role']}</td></tr>"
                               for u in api.users.values())
            return 200, f"<h1>Usuarios</h1><table><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>", {}
        if parts[:1] != ["users"]:
            return 404, {"error": "route_not_found", "path": path}, {}
        if self.headers.get("Authorization") != f"Bearer {TOKEN}":
            return 401, {"error": "unauthorized"}, {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
        with api.lock:
            return self.users(api, method, parts[1:], query, body)

    def users(self, api: FakeApi, method: str, rest: list[str], query: dict[str, str],
              body: Any) -> Reply:
        if not rest and method == "GET":
            page, size = int(query.get("page", "1")), int(query.get("size", "10"))
            if page < 1 or not 1 <= size <= 100:
                return 400, {"error": "invalid_pagination"}, {}
            rows = [u for u in api.users.values() if query.get("role") in (None, u["role"])]
            items = rows[(page - 1) * size:page * size]
            return 200, {"items": items, "page": page, "size": size, "total": len(rows)}, {}
        if not rest and method == "POST":
            if errors := user_errors(body, partial=False):
                return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
            if any(u["email"] == body["email"] for u in api.users.values()):
                return 409, {"error": "email_taken", "email": body["email"]}, {}
            user = api.users[api.next_id] = {"id": api.next_id, "active": True} | body
            api.next_id += 1
            return 201, user, {"Location": f"/users/{user['id']}"}
        if len(rest) != 1 or not rest[0].isdigit():
            return 400, {"error": "invalid_id", "value": "/".join(rest)}, {}
        user_id = int(rest[0])
        if (current := api.users.get(user_id)) is None:
            return 404, {"error": "not_found", "id": user_id}, {}
        if method == "GET":
            return 200, current, {}
        if method == "DELETE":
            del api.users[user_id]
            return 204, None, {}
        if method not in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            return 405, {"error": "method_not_allowed"}, {}
        if errors := user_errors(body, partial=method == "PATCH"):
            return 422, {"error": "validation_error", "fields": errors}, {}
        base = current if method == "PATCH" else {"id": user_id, "active": True}
        api.users[user_id] = base | body | {"id": user_id}
        return 200, api.users[user_id], {}


@contextmanager
def running_api() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    server = FakeApi()
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        yield server
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
# --- Fin de la API falsa compacta ---


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def api_server() -> Iterator[FakeApi]:
    with running_api() as server:
        yield server


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def playwright_instance() -> Iterator[Playwright]:
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        yield playwright


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")

@pytest.fixture
```
